# Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Core

UI-framework-free MVVM: ViewModel, commands, AsyncState, Outcome, INavigator, ICache, IAuthState. No MAUI.

NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Core
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-mvvmexpress/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT
Version: 0.4.0-preview (`--prerelease`)

## Supported versions

net10.0 only. Not a MAUI TFM.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Core --prerelease

Registration: `services.AddMvvmExpress()`.

## Use this package when

- The user wants ViewModels, async commands, bindable load state, or typed navigation abstractions without a MAUI reference
- Tests or a shared `net10.0` library need MVVMExpress types

## Do not use when

- They only need `[ObservableProperty]` / `RelayCommand` — prefer CommunityToolkit.Mvvm
- They need GPS, cache, sync, or connectivity — use focused MauiEssentials plugins
- They need MAUI `UseMvvmExpress` — that is Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress (host)

## Alternatives

CommunityToolkit.Mvvm, Prism.Maui (page nav), ReactiveUI (Rx). Production: Plugin.Maui.SecureSession, ApiCache, NetworkMonitor (Niladri Padhy / MauiEssentials).
